name: a launch writes one dispatch in the orchestrator's activity file with agent, role, ticket, description and tool-use id
a launch for work with no ticket (#-) writes a dispatch with no ticket
a resume writes a dispatch keyed by resumedAgentId, carrying the role, ticket and description of the agent's launch
a message to a running agent writes a message event (a cause edge), not a dispatch
a Cause: line in the prompt or message becomes the event's cause
on recorded calls, each dispatch's agent is the agent_id of the agent.start it caused
a well-formed challenge is written with its kind, rebut by default, and its ticket as a number
a challenge whose target does not parse, or is prose, is refused and nothing is written
a challenge of an unknown kind, or with an id that is not a plain name, is refused
a target is a pointer, a decision row (row:N) or an event (event:<run>/<agent>:<line>)
challenge.eliminated names a challenge already in the stream, from any run
challenge.eliminated naming no challenge in the stream is refused and nothing is written
a challenge reusing an id already in the stream is refused, so of=<id> names one challenge
a story-map row naming a check that is no check:* script fails, naming the row
a story-map row naming a test that no test file declares fails, naming the row
a test run writes an artifact listing each test name with its result
CI logs its per-test results and a ci check naming the commit, failing on any problem
